rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose way to say that you are going shopping or buying things, without specifying the method.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 soeng1 coeng4 maai5 je5

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken term for a physical retail shop; an online shop is usually called 網店 instead.

example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 maai6 man4 geoi6

rows.note: Use this when the shopping or purchasing is done online rather than in physical shops.

example.english: I usually shop online because home delivery is much more convenient.
example.traditional: 我通常上網買嘢，送貨上門方便好多。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung1 soeng4 soeng5 mong5 maai5 je5 sung3 fo3 soeng6 mun4 fong1 bin6 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a garage or vehicle repair shop.

example.english: My car needs to go into the repair shop.
example.jyutping: ngo5 bou6 ce1 jiu3 jap6 ce1 fong2 zing2

rows.note: Use this for a hair salon or the usual barber-and-hairdressing shop.

example.english: That shop gives really good haircuts.
example.traditional: 嗰間髮型屋剪頭髮好掂。
example.jyutping: go2 gaan1 faat3 jing4 uk1 zin2 tau4 faat3 hou2 dim6

rows.note: Use this for a place where goods are made or crafted, rather than an ordinary retail shop.

example.english: This shop specializes in making wooden furniture.
example.traditional: 呢間工場專門整木製傢俬。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gung1 coeng4 zyun1 mun4 zing2 muk6 zai3 gaa1 si1
